title: WE GOT MEME'D! | COPICafe Episode 37 | Cornucopias
description:
Updates on the racing game, Solace and some great community generated memes as well! 



In episode 37 of COPI Cafe, Rob and Josh discuss the latest Meme contest for the #YearOfTheCorn challenge on Twitter. Josh Discusses our 2023 road map and future deliverables. Rob talks in depth about our Metaverse Launcher that is currently being built. The guys discuss progress being made with our racing game and share some juicy details. They then go on to share even more leaks to for the public to see! 

00:00 - Beverage Choices
02:26 Meme Contest
08:45 2023 Roadmap
15:21 Metaverse Launcher
22:40 Racing Game
30:00 Solace
31:48 Leaks

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw


#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK


https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
